Each later installed/reinstalled engine must match an exact pre-launch fully enforced outbound program rule.

firstWindowsAttempt.failure: Offline-window semantic test failed on its first child process constructor with file not found. Source-level reproduction established that Get-Command node can return multiple Application matches, coercing to a nonexistent joined filename. The exact runtime value was not logged, so this is the supported cause rather than an observed CI value.
firstWindowsAttempt.correction: Pass the actual Node test process.execPath explicitly; validate one absolute existing executable and exercise multiple inert PATH candidates without executing them. Coordinator selects one first ApplicationInfo, validates the exact absolute existing node.exe and reuses it for every controller invocation and both callback arguments; source-bound multiple-match regressions passed.

firstCoreAttempt.correction: Classify only three exact path/full-byte SHA256 matches; reject any drift even without URLs, and continue to reject copied runtime or sibling content.
